definitions.gloss: north and south, from north to south
definitions.explanation: The two directions of north and south, or the extent/distance in that direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南北|なんぼく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Japan is a country that stretches long from north to south.

examples.japanese: {南北|なんぼく}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The North-South problem is a serious issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南北|なんぼく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南北|なんぼく}⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧50⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧、⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧20⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This island is about 50 km from north to south and about 20 km from east to west.

examples.japanese: {南北|なんぼく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧、⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, which stretches long from north to south, the climate and culture differ greatly between the north and south.

notes:
USAGE: {南北|なんぼく} describes the north-south axis or orientation. Note the reading order - it's なんぼく (south-north) even though English says 'north-south.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {南北|なんぼく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long from north to south)
- {南北|なんぼく}⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧X⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧ (approximately X km north to south)
- {南北|なんぼく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run north-south)

COMPOUNDS:
- {南北|なんぼく}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (North-South problem - economic disparity)
- {南北|なんぼく}⟦{朝鮮|ちょうせん}→朝鮮：noentry⟧ (North and South Korea)
- {南北|なんぼく}⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧ (American Civil War)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {南北|なんぼく} - north-south
- ⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧ - east-west
